name: get_detailed_expenses_report
script:
# Server Script: get_detailed_expenses_report
# Type: API

# أسماء الجداول
parent_doctype = "law cases"
child_doctype = "Law Case Expenses"

parent_table = f"`tab{parent_doctype}`"
child_table = f"`tab{child_doctype}`"

# 1. إعداد الشروط
conditions = ["1=1"]
values = {}

# 2. الفلاتر

# فلتر العميل (client)
client = frappe.form_dict.get("client")
if client:
    conditions.append("parent.clientid = %(client)s")
    values["client"] = client

# فلتر رقم القضية (case_number)
case_number = frappe.form_dict.get("case_number")
if case_number:
    conditions.append("parent.name LIKE %(case_number)s")
    values["case_number"] = f"%{case_number}%"

# فلتر من تاريخ المصروف (from_date)
from_date = frappe.form_dict.get("from_date")
if from_date:
    conditions.append("child.expensedate >= %(from_date)s")
    values["from_date"] = from_date

# فلتر إلى تاريخ المصروف (to_date)
to_date = frappe.form_dict.get("to_date")
if to_date:
    conditions.append("child.expensedate <= %(to_date)s")
    values["to_date"] = to_date

# تجميع شرط WHERE
where_clause = " AND ".join(conditions)

# 3. الاستعلام
# نقوم بعمل JOIN بين الجدول الأب (القضايا) والجدول الابن (المصاريف)
# الحقل parent في الجدول الابن يربطه بالجدول الأب
query = f"""
    SELECT
        child.name as expense_id,
        parent.name as case_id,
        parent.naming_series as file_number,
        parent.clientname as client_name,
        parent.clientid as client_id,
        child.expenseamount as amount,
        child.expensedate as expense_date,
        child.notes as expense_notes
    FROM
        {child_table} child
    INNER JOIN
        {parent_table} parent ON child.parent = parent.name
    WHERE
        {where_clause}
    ORDER BY
        child.expensedate DESC, parent.name DESC
"""

data = frappe.db.sql(query, values, as_dict=True)

# 4. التنسيق النهائي
final_result = []
for index, row in enumerate(data, start=1):
    ordered_row = {
        "Sr": index,
        "رقم القضية": row['case_id'],       # ID القضية (name)
        "رقم الملف": row['file_number'] or "", # naming_series
        "تاريخ المصروف": row['expense_date'],
        "المبلغ": row['amount'] or 0,
        "اسم العميل": row['client_name'] or row['client_id'] or "",
        "ملاحظات": row['expense_notes'] or ""
    }
    final_result.append(ordered_row)

frappe.response['message'] = final_result
